### Fix 3: Update pricing calculation to ensure minimum 2,500,000 Tomans

```typescript:src/lib/pricingUtils.ts
// ... existing code ...

export const calculateTotalPrice = (data: PricingData): PricingBreakdown => {
  const siteTypeConfig = data.siteType ? PRICING_CONFIG.siteTypes[data.siteType] : null;
  const basePrice = siteTypeConfig?.basePrice || 0;
  
  const customizationLevel = data.pricing?.customizationLevel?.[0] || 3;
  const modulesPrice = calculateModulesPrice(data.modules || [], customizationLevel);
  
  const additionalServicesPrice = calculateAdditionalServicesPrice(
    data.pricing?.additionalServices || []
  );
  
  const packagePrice = calculatePackagePrice(data.pricing?.selectedPackage || '');
  
  // Calculate dynamic design pages and sections cost
  const { pagesCost, sectionsCost } = calculateDynamicDesignPrice(data);
  
  // Calculate the main cost (either package price or site type base + modules, whichever is higher)
  const mainCost = Math.max(packagePrice, basePrice + modulesPrice);
  
  // Package discount if modules cost less than package
  const packageDiscount = packagePrice > 0 ? Math.max(0, packagePrice - (basePrice + modulesPrice)) : 0;
  
  const subtotal = mainCost + additionalServicesPrice + pagesCost + sectionsCost;
  const rushDeliveryFee = calculateRushDeliveryFee(subtotal, data.pricing?.rushDelivery || false);
  
  let totalPrice = subtotal + rushDeliveryFee;
  
  // Ensure minimum price of 2,500,000 Tomans
  totalPrice = Math.max(totalPrice, 2500000);
  
  return {
    basePrice,
    modulesPrice,
    additionalServicesPrice,
    packagePrice,
    pagesCost,
    sectionsCost,
    rushDeliveryFee,
    totalPrice,
    packageDiscount
  };
};
```

const handleDeleteOrder = async (order: Order) => {
  if (!confirm('آیا از حذف این سفارش اطمینان دارید؟')) return;

  try {
    // If order was paid, refund to user's wallet

      const refundTransactionId = await WalletService.refundOrder(order.id);
      if (refundTransactionId) {
        toast({
          title: 'بازپرداخت انجام شد',

        });

          title: 'خطا در بازپرداخت',

          variant: 'destructive',
        });
      }
    }

// ... existing code ...

const WalletCard = ({ userId }: { userId: string }) => {
  const [wallet, setWallet] = useState<Wallet | null>(null);
  const [transactions, setTransactions] = useState<Transaction[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [depositAmount, setDepositAmount] = useState('');
  const [isDepositing, setIsDepositing] = useState(false);
  const { toast } = useToast();

  // ... existing fetch functions ...

  const handleDeposit = async () => {
    const amount = parseFloat(depositAmount);
    if (!amount || amount < 1000) {
      toast({
        title: 'خطا',
        description: 'مبلغ باید حداقل 1,000 تومان باشد',
        variant: 'destructive',
      });
      return;
    }

    setIsDepositing(true);
    try {
      // Create deposit transaction
      const transactionId = await WalletService.processTransaction(
        userId,
        'deposit',
        amount,
        'شارژ کیف پول',
        undefined,
        'deposit',
        { method: 'zarinpal' }
      );

      if (transactionId) {
        // Initiate Zarinpal payment for deposit
        const paymentRequest = {
          action: 'request',
          amount: Math.floor(amount / 10), // Convert from Rials to Tomans
          description: `شارژ کیف پول - ${formatPrice(amount)} تومان`,
          orderId: transactionId
        };

        const { data: paymentData, error: paymentError } = await supabase.functions.invoke('zarinpal-payment', {
          body: paymentRequest
        });

        if (paymentError) throw paymentError;

        if (paymentData.success) {
          window.location.href = paymentData.paymentUrl;
        } else {
          throw new Error('Failed to create payment request');
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing deposit:', error);
      toast({
        title: 'خطا در شارژ کیف پول',
        description: 'مشکلی در پردازش شارژ پیش آمد',
        variant: 'destructive',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsDepositing(false);
    }
  };

  // ... rest of component ...
};

### Fix 7: Add wallet payment option to order submission

```typescript:src/components/wizard/OrderSubmissionStep.tsx
// ... existing code ...

const OrderSubmissionStep = ({ data }: OrderSubmissionStepProps) => {
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = useState<'zarinpal' | 'wallet'>('zarinpal');
  const [walletBalance, setWalletBalance] = useState(0);
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  // Fetch wallet balance
  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) {
      WalletService.getWalletBalance(user.id).then(setWalletBalance);
    }
  }, [user]);

  const pricingBreakdown = calculateTotalPrice(data);
  const totalCost = pricingBreakdown.totalPrice;

  const submitOrder = async () => {
    if (!user) {
      toast({
        title: "خطا",
        description: "برای ثبت سفارش باید وارد شوید",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
      navigate('/auth');
      return;
    }

    setIsProcessing(true);

    try {
      // Create order first
      const orderData = {
        user_id: user.id,
        title: `وب‌سایت ${data.siteType === 'personal' ? 'شخصی' : 'تجاری'} - ${data.userInfo?.domain || 'mywebsite'}`,
        description: JSON.stringify({
          siteType: data.siteType,
          websiteFramework: data.websiteFramework,
          modules: data.modules,
          branding: data.branding,
          userInfo: data.userInfo,
          pricing: data.pricing,
          moduleLayout: data.modules?.map((m: any, index: number) => ({
            ...m,
            position: index
          }))
        }),
        price: totalCost,
        status: 'pending',
        payment_status: 'pending',
        comments: `دامنه: ${data.userInfo?.domain || 'mywebsite'}.ir`
      };

      const { data: newOrder, error } = await supabase
        .from('orders')
        .insert([orderData])
        .select()
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;

      // Handle payment based on selected method
      if (paymentMethod === 'wallet') {
        if (walletBalance < totalCost) {
          toast({
            title: "موجودی ناکافی",
            description: `موجودی کیف پول شما ${formatPrice(walletBalance)} تومان است`,
            variant: "destructive",
          });
          return;
        }

        // Pay from wallet
        const transactionId = await WalletService.payForOrder(
          user.id,
          newOrder.id,
          totalCost,
          orderData.title
        );

        if (transactionId) {
          // Update order status
          await supabase
            .from('orders')
            .update({
              payment_status: 'paid',
              status: 'confirmed'
            })
            .eq('id', newOrder.id);

          toast({
            title: "پرداخت موفق",
            description: "سفارش شما با موفقیت ثبت شد",
          });

          navigate('/dashboard');
        } else {
          throw new Error('خطا در پرداخت از کیف پول');
        }
      } else {
        // Zarinpal payment (existing code)
        const paymentRequest = {
          action: 'request',
          amount: Math.floor(totalCost / 10),
          description: `پرداخت سفارش وب‌سایت - ${data.userInfo?.domain || 'mywebsite'}`,
          orderId: newOrder.id
        };

        const { data: paymentData, error: paymentError } = await supabase.functions.invoke('zarinpal-payment', {
          body: paymentRequest
        });

        if (paymentError) throw paymentError;

        if (paymentData.success) {
          window.location.href = paymentData.paymentUrl;
        } else {
          throw new Error('Failed to create payment request');
        }
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Order submission error:', error);
      toast({
        title: "خطا در ثبت سفارش",
        description: error.message || "مشکلی در ثبت سفارش پیش آمد",
        variant: "destructive",
      });
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // ... rest of component with payment method selection UI ...
};
```

3. **Missing 'saved' Status**: The database constraint didn't allow the `'saved'` status that your application was trying to use.

- Profile creation/updates should work without conflicts
- The "Save and pay later" functionality should work with the `'saved'` status

The errors should be resolved once these changes are applied and the database migrations are run.

  static async getWalletBalance(userId: string): Promise<number> {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('wallets')
        .select('balance')
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .single();

      if (error) {

        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .single();

      if (error) {

        // If wallet doesn't exist, create one

## Solution 3: Update the Database Function to Handle Missing Wallets

Let's also update the database function to automatically create a wallet if it doesn't exist:

```sql:supabase/migrations/20250728000002-update-process-wallet-transaction.sql
-- Update the process_wallet_transaction function to create wallet if it doesn't exist
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_wallet_transaction(
  p_user_id UUID,
  p_type transaction_type,
  p_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
  p_description TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_reference_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
  p_reference_type TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_metadata JSONB DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS UUID
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_wallet_id UUID;
  v_balance_before DECIMAL(12,2);
  v_balance_after DECIMAL(12,2);
  v_transaction_id UUID;
BEGIN
  -- Get user's wallet, create if doesn't exist
  SELECT id, balance INTO v_wallet_id, v_balance_before
  FROM public.wallets
  WHERE user_id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    -- Create wallet for user
    INSERT INTO public.wallets (user_id, balance)
    VALUES (p_user_id, 0.00)
    RETURNING id, balance INTO v_wallet_id, v_balance_before;
  END IF;
  
  -- Calculate new balance based on transaction type
  CASE p_type
    WHEN 'deposit', 'refund', 'credit' THEN
      v_balance_after := v_balance_before + p_amount;
    WHEN 'withdrawal', 'payment', 'debit' THEN
      v_balance_after := v_balance_before - p_amount;
      IF v_balance_after < 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Insufficient funds. Required: %, Available: %', p_amount, v_balance_before;
      END IF;
  END CASE;
  
  -- Create transaction record
  INSERT INTO public.transactions (
    wallet_id,
    user_id,
    type,
    status,
    amount,
    balance_before,
    balance_after,
    description,
    reference_id,
    reference_type,
    metadata
  ) VALUES (
    v_wallet_id,
    p_user_id,
    p_type,
    'completed',
    p_amount,
    v_balance_before,
    v_balance_after,
    p_description,
    p_reference_id,
    p_reference_type,
    p_metadata
  ) RETURNING id INTO v_transaction_id;
  
  -- Update wallet balance
  UPDATE public.wallets
  SET balance = v_balance_after
  WHERE id = v_wallet_id;
  
  RETURN v_transaction_id;
END;
$$;
```

Tool use: **edit_file**


<details><summary>Edit file: supabase/migrations/20250728000001-create-missing-wallets.sql</summary>

I will create a migration to ensure all existing users have wallets by creating wallets for users who don't have one.

**Chunk 1**
Lines added: 16, lines removed: 1

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,16 @@
- 
+ -- Create wallets for existing users who don't have one
+ INSERT INTO public.wallets (user_id, balance)
+ SELECT 
+   u.id as user_id,
+   0.00 as balance
+ FROM auth.users u
+ LEFT JOIN public.wallets w ON u.id = w.user_id
+ WHERE w.id IS NULL;
+ 
+ -- Also ensure the trigger is properly set up
+ -- Drop and recreate the trigger to ensure it's working
+ DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS on_auth_user_created_wallet ON auth.users;
+ 
+ CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created_wallet
+   AFTER INSERT ON auth.users
+   FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE public.create_user_wallet(); 
```

## Summary of Solutions 2, 3, and 4

### Solution 2: Updated WalletService
- **Added `createWallet()` method** to manually create wallets when needed
- **Enhanced `getWalletBalance()` and `getWallet()`** to automatically create wallets if they don't exist (checking for `PGRST116` error code)
- **Updated `processTransaction()`** to ensure wallet exists before processing transactions
- **Graceful error handling** that creates missing wallets instead of failing

### Solution 3: Updated Database Function
- **Modified `process_wallet_transaction()` function** to automatically create a wallet if it doesn't exist
- **Added `IF NOT FOUND` logic** to check for missing wallets and create them on-the-fly
- **Maintains transaction integrity** by using `FOR UPDATE` lock and proper error handling
- **Ensures all users have wallets** without manual intervention

### Solution 4: Added Wallet Tables to TypeScript Types
- **Added `wallets` table definition** with proper relationships to `auth.users`
- **Added `transactions` table definition** with relationships to both `wallets` and `auth.users`
- **Added transaction enums** (`transaction_type` and `transaction_status`) to the database schema
- **Proper TypeScript types** for all wallet-related operations
- **Maintained existing interfaces** (`Wallet`, `Transaction`, etc.) for backward compatibility

### Additional Migration: Create Missing Wallets
- **Migration to create wallets** for all existing users who don't have one
- **Recreates the trigger** to ensure it works properly for new users
- **One-time fix** to ensure all existing users have wallets

## How These Solutions Work Together

1. **Frontend (Solution 2)**: The `WalletService` now handles missing wallets gracefully by creating them automatically
2. **Backend (Solution 3)**: The database function also creates missing wallets, providing a double safety net
3. **Type Safety (Solution 4)**: TypeScript now knows about wallet tables, enabling proper API generation and type checking
4. **Data Migration**: Existing users get wallets created automatically

After applying these changes and running the migrations, the wallet error should be completely resolved. The system will now:
- Automatically create wallets for any user who doesn't have one
- Handle wallet operations gracefully without errors
- Provide proper TypeScript support for all wallet functionality
- Ensure all existing users have wallets

The error "Wallet not found for user" should no longer occur, and the wallet functionality should work seamlessly for all users.
